source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes one FRU_PSU endpoint, samples three identity fields plus dynamic Status through curl -k and omits PSU count/slot mapping, complete IPMI parity and static/live separation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires every PSU member, exact slot/IPMI mapping, full identity/status evidence and a no-power/no-write boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 974/2291 accepts the assumed four-field endpoint as direct evidence.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Power-supply live telemetry and redundancy tests are separate; inventory identity cannot validate capacity or removal/failover behavior.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI/IPMI evidence; ED-34 permits approved collectors; ED-35 preserves all PSU slots and static/live coverage; ED-36 treats topology/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify PSU FRU information is readable and correct across BMC WebUI and read-only IPMI for every installed supply.
original_method: Enumerate all PSU members, map each to physical slot and IPMI FRU device, collect complete protected static identity plus separately timed live Status, and compare with WebUI and approved power/build references without changing power or modules.
manual_activity: The owner supplies PSU slot/feed topology, expected FRU fields and live status semantics. The agent may read and reconcile evidence; electrical/redundancy behavior and final verdict remain engineer-owned.
required_inputs: PSU count, slot and feed topology
safety_requirements: Do not edit FRU, unplug/reseat a PSU, change power policy, power-cycle or reset.
Do not assume one FRU_PSU URI covers every supply.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Separate static identity/rating from live power Status.
Stop on ambiguous slot/feed mapping or stale status without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate all PSU and related chassis members.
Bind each PSU to physical slot/feed and IPMI FRU target.
Collect complete redacted identity/rating and timestamped live status/health evidence.
Correlate WebUI, IPMI and approved reference per slot.
Return evidence only with power and FRU state unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve PSU topology and device mapping.
Approve static field and live-status semantics.
Review mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial assumed read only; one URI/four fields cannot prove every PSU, slot/feed identity, full IPMI/UI parity, ratings or trusted live status.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate actual PSU resources, map every slot and compare complete protected static FRU separately from time-stamped live power/health state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_PSU, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use complete per-slot PSU FRU parity plus a separate live-status checkpoint under no-power/no-write constraints.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PSU topology/FRU definition and Project power/build matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-slot/feed enumeration, complete protected fields and static/live separation while retaining WebUI/IPMI validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One four-field object cannot establish all supplies, ratings, redundancy or electrical behavior; inventory is not a failover test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: PSU topology, full field baseline and live status policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or stale PSU resource may look plausible; physical/power actions can cause outage and remain excluded.

project_override_considerations: Alternate collectors require exact per-slot/feed identity, equivalent static and live fields, engineer approval and disclosure of uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage; they do not authorize PSU manipulation.
expected_evidence: Complete PSU slot/feed and resource/IPMI map
Raw redacted per-PSU FRU and timestamped status
Normalized static identity/rating matrix plus live status/health assessment

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests PSU FRU parity; dynamic Status in DeepSeek is an additional checkpoint whose semantics need definition, not a conflicting purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PSU inventory purpose is clear; topology, expected fields and live-status semantics are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds all-member enumeration, slot/feed/IPMI mapping, full fields and static/live separation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-power/no-write controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces assumed single-endpoint acceptance with topology, completeness and freshness gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps inventory distinct from PSU power/redundancy testing.

review_improvement: Prevents one plausible PSU object or stale Status from hiding a missing/swapped supply and avoids promoting inventory to electrical redundancy coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Multi-PSU platforms require per-slot/feed identity because a single aggregate or guessed resource can miss a failed or swapped unit. Persistent FRU fields and live power Status have different authorities and timing; neither proves redundancy, and no inventory review authorizes unplug or power action.
